integrity: The proof specializes the published recurrence formula to the two classified minimum languages, uses the exact Pell-type denominator recurrence, and determines all subsequential normalized limits. A standalone verifier checks the closed form, endpoint normalization, and finite approximations for both directive initializations.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is an asymptotic consequence of the published exact recurrence-function formula for the two minimum-critical-exponent complementary-symmetric Rote languages. It does not classify recurrence quotients for arbitrary Rote languages and does not reprove the return-word theorem.
title: Exact recurrence-quotient interval at the minimum Rote critical exponent
